notes.title: 2.0 Update
notes.content: [p]- 2025 Season 2 begins![/p][p]- Campaign mercenary selection (2 types) upon clearing all campaigns?![/p][p]- New mercenary "Tax Collector" added![/p][p]- New card "Lobster Monster", "Broken Token" added![/p][p]- Higher-level achievements added[/p][p]- Ranked point system reworked[/p][p]- Daily ranking expanded to top 25 players[/p][p]- Main menu redesigned[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where only carrots were consumed and the card wasn't obtained when purchasing with golden carrots under certain conditions[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where reconnection could fail under certain conditions[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where Gorani’s congratulatory sound in the result screen was not affected by volume settings[/p][p]- Fixed a visual issue where scarecrows that change area score appeared to activate even when removed (they did not activate on the server)[/p]

- The Carrot Festival has begun! It’s the perfect chance to earn carrots. For two weeks, ranked game rewards and daily quest rewards are greatly increased, and carrot recharge prices are significantly discounted for a limited time. Don’t miss out!
- Bug fixes
